summary: Make four ketiv forms robust: where one letter has two vowels, put a CGJ (U+034F) between them, as MAM's Scripture text does, so that the order given holds under any normalization or shaping engine. 2 Kgs 18:27: after the yod's sheva; Ezek 14:14, 14:20 and 28:3: after the nun's ḥiriq
